title: ExtendFootprintTTL whose operation source is a muxed account
description: A successful ExtendFootprintTTL operation whose operation source is an M… address with mux ID 1234567890123456789; the transaction source is the same account in G… form. The envelope names the muxed form; the meta only ever shows the base G… account changing. A reader that seeds participants from the envelope records an M… participant that is not an account, or cuts it to 32 bytes.

shapes.note: Core checks the base account and its signatures; the 64-bit mux ID is passed through. wallet-backend#753 states core rejects a muxed source only on InvokeHostFunction from protocol 25.

generator.command: docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:18000:8000 stellar/quickstart --local --protocol-version 28 --enable core,rpc; node generator/muxed_soroban_source.mjs SDK_DIR http://127.0.0.1:18000/rpc OUT_DIR

decoded.why: The operation source in the envelope is muxed.
The transaction source is the plain account.
Core applied it: a muxed source on this operation is valid at protocol 28.
The only account the meta shows changing is the G… account.

notes: Generated on 2026-11-17 against stellar/quickstart (core v30.0.0) held at protocol 28, so the header uses the SIGNED StellarValue arm that the pre-fix wallet-backend commits decode. The funding account is the network root account and the test account's seed is sha256("xdr-corpus muxed-soroban-source"); no external keys. Soroban resources were set by hand because the quickstart RPC failed to simulate at protocol 28. js-stellar-sdk 17.3.0 refuses to build a Soroban operation with a muxed source, so the recipe sets the source on the envelope before signing. The bytes are not reproducible (close time, ledger number); the shape is. This payload is from the second run of the recipe, on a fresh network (run record: repro/evidence/gen-muxed-soroban-source.recipe-run.json); the first run gave a ledger of the same size and shape at sequence 102. All four verdicts were measured the same day (repro/README.md): at 79ea2acd1dc6 the ledger is ingested with two participant rows, the G… key and an M-prefixed 32-byte key that is not a valid address (#716); at f8e5786d22c0 ingestion halts on a duplicate key in transactions_accounts (#753); at bb0b162b0725 only the G… account is stored.
